# proxmox_node_apt_repositories (Data Source)

Lists the APT source files of one node from `/nodes/{node}/apt/repositories`, sorted by path, including the entry index position used by `proxmox_node_apt_repository`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_apt_repositories" "node1" {
  node = "pve-1"
}
```
